findings.text: `Database.selectQuery?` handles every non-query resolved statement with a catch-all, so a new statement constructor will not require explicit handling. Fix: enumerate the error and resolved-statement constructors.
`exists_sorted_of_mem_possibleResults_window` states a model-only fact but resides in the surface package. Fix: move the theorem into the model and retain its tactic registration in the surface.

The six new `Value.isNull` lemmas lack proof sketches although `sql_select_simp` uses them in other proofs. Fix: document definitional reduction for the constructor equations and case analysis for the two equivalences.
Both new integer comparison lemmas lack proof sketches although the tactic uses them in other proofs. Fix: describe the Boolean comparison reduction and the natural-number cast reduction.
`Query.keepsGroup_of_having` explains why the theorem exists but gives no proof sketch. Fix: describe function extensionality followed by substitution of the HAVING premise and simplification.
`Query.rowOutput_eq` lacks a proof sketch although it is registered for use in other proofs. Fix: state that unfolding `Query.rowOutput` gives the equation.
`comparisonOperands_none` lacks a proof sketch although it is registered for use in other proofs. Fix: state that the no-affinity branch reduces definitionally.

The new tests exercise built-in successful proofs but do not test the public registry’s rejection of non-theorems, local registration expiry, or deterministic rule order. Fix: add focused fixtures that fail when each of these behaviors is removed.

The commit implements the extension syntax while `docs/select-automation-acceptance.md` still labels it “not yet implemented.” Fix: update that documentation to identify the implemented syntax and retain explicit labels for outstanding acceptance work.
